channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US singer Mary Millben targets Abhijeet Dipke again; says PM Modi doesn't need US support, predicts 2029 win
item.description: US singer Mary Millben advised the CJP leader to pivot his political approach and urged Abhijeet Dipke to leverage his “US education, talent, and use it for good”.

item.title: Rain, hailstorm likely in Delhi today? IMD shares weather update, predicts heavy rainfall in Kerala, Tamil Nadu
item.description: The IMD said isolated very heavy rainfall is likely over Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal on October 15. It also predicted hailstorm activity in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and Haryana.

item.title: Who is Pramila Jayapal? Chennai-born US Democrat backing protests in India over SIR, deletion of 13 crore voters
item.description: The Democratic Congresswoman from Washington state has said she supported the non-violent protests to counter ‘anti-democratic efforts in India’ and that the developments in India appear to be a similar playbook to what the Trump Administration is doing in the US.

item.title: Ukraine's Starlink restrictions: Zelenskyy vs Elon Musk — Why is ‘Starshield’ so important in battlefield | Explained
item.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reportedly raised concerns over disruptions to Starlink connectivity.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 15: How much does fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged on Thursday, but the CNG cost has risen by ₹2/L in at least 8 states

item.title: What Trump-Putin's diesel deal, Musk-owned Starlink curbs mean for Zelensky's Ukraine?
item.description: US President Trump’s Russian oil sanctions waiver and Starlink restrictions threaten Ukraine’s drone warfare and expose Zelensky to fresh pressure from Washington.

item.title: NTPC seeks ₹1.5-trillion Rosatom tie-up for six nuclear reactors
item.description: The state-run generator has pitched for six unbuilt reactors under a 2014 bilateral pact as it targets 30GW of nuclear capacity by 2047.

item.title: Social Security COLA 2027: 3.6% increase adds $75 a month, but retirees say it’s not enough
item.description: The adjustment will affect nearly 72 million people receiving monthly Social Security benefits and about 7.3 million beneficiaries enrolled in Supplemental Security Income (SSI), according to the announcement.

item.title: Trump personally coached Katie Zacharia before 14-minute briefing; what happened
item.description: Zacharia's first appearance at the podium lasted around 14 minutes, with approximately eight minutes devoted to praising Trump and six minutes spent answering questions.

item.title: US midterm elections: What election officials fear Trump could do before and after Election Day
item.description: The investigation, based on interviews with more than 50 election officials, voting experts and election lawyers, examines how the Trump administration could test the limits of federal authority before and after Election Day.

item.title: Zelensky urges Musk to ‘switch on’ Starlink as Ukraine flags US ‘difficulties’ amid military disruptions
item.description: Ukraine’s President Zelensky urged Elon Musk to switch on Starlink after reported disruptions affected military drone operations. Kyiv has also flagged difficulties in its partnership with the US over satellite communications and intelligence sharing.

item.title: Bengaluru employee says manager denied Dussehra leave days after placing him on PIP, internet says ‘New layoff strategy’
item.description: A Bengaluru-based fresher has claimed on Reddit that his manager placed him on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) and denied two days of leave for a planned Dussehra trip home.&nbsp;

item.title: Kerala Hotels and Restaurants to stop accepting UPI payments above ₹2,000 from Oct 15
item.description: Kerala Hotel and Restaurant Association protests proposed merchant charges; NPCI defers implementation of 0.4% MDR framework

item.title: Mauritius rocked by worst riots since 1999: How a police shooting triggered unrest | Explained
item.description: Mauritius has been rocked by its worst riots since 1999 after water shortages and rising living costs fuelled public anger. A woman’s shooting by police escalated tensions, triggering vandalism and clashes. Authorities imposed a curfew as the government faced mounting pressure to restore order.

item.title: Telangana man saves ₹10 coins for 3 years to buy ₹1.23 lakh Honda Activa - Video
item.description: Joseph said he had hoped to buy a Royal Enfield Bullet but had to abandon the plan because of financial constraints.

item.title: Wisconsin plane crash kills six, including child — What happened before the aircraft disappeared from radar?
item.description: The six-seat, single-engine Piper PA-46 aircraft was travelling from Kenosha to Menomonie when it crashed near Mirror Lake State Park in the Town of Dellona shortly before 10 pm local time, authorities said.

item.title: ‘Stay indoors during aerial attacks’: India issues fresh advisory for nationals in Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes
item.description: India has issued a fresh advisory urging nationals in Saudi Arabia to stay indoors during aerial attacks, follow local authorities’ instructions and avoid circulating videos or news. The embassy also updated citizens on injured Indians, flight disruptions, visa overstays and its 24-hour helpline.

item.title: Why RSS affiliate wants Centre to deny Elon Musk's Starlink a licence for satellite internet in India
item.description: Swadeshi Jagran Manch (SJM), an affiliate of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), has urged the Centre to deny Elon Musk-owned Starlink a licence for commercial satellite broadband services in India, citing concerns over internet shutdowns, data routing and national security.

item.title: New audit framework for multi-state cooperative societies by centre: What is it?
item.description: Ministry of Cooperation has introduced a new audit reporting framework to identify financial stress in Cooperative Societies early. The ministry has issued an official statement.

item.title: Lost luggage at Hyderabad airport? You can now track lost and found items in real time
item.description: The airport has launched a digital platform that allows passengers to report lost items, track their requests, and communicate with the Lost and Found team through a single interface.

item.title: 18 years in Dubai, 2 years of trying luck: Punjab truck driver wins ₹1.23 crore in UAE draw; here's what he said
item.description: Punjab truck driver Kulwant Singh, who has lived in Dubai for 18 years, won nearly ₹1.23 crore in Abu Dhabi Big Ticket’s Series 291 with five friends. Kerala engineer Muhammed Ijas C. won approximately ₹24.5 lakh with a number inspired by his son’s birthday.&nbsp;

item.title: India's US oil and gas imports plunged 43% in September as West Asia supplies recovered despite Trump’s push: Report
item.description: India’s imports of US crude oil, LNG and LPG fell 43% in September to a five-month low, while supplies from West Asia surged 67%. The shift comes as Gulf exports recover and US President Donald Trump pushes New Delhi to buy more American energy.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg, wife Priscilla’s Irish castle cost €51 million—And the price is nearly double initial estimate
item.description: The €51.17 million purchase of Strancally Castle adds to Zuckerberg's property holdings and provides a family base in Ireland, where Meta maintains its European headquarters.

item.title: India’s data centres may consume up to 2% of electricity in a decade, says NITI Aayog member
item.description: Data centres currently account for around 0.5% of India’s electricity consumption, but their share could rise to 1-2% over the next decade as digital infrastructure expands, NITI Aayog Member Abhay Karandikar said.&nbsp;

item.title: Govt has no plans to reduce import duties on pulses for now: Consumer Affairs Secretary Nidhi Khare
item.description: Higher kharif acreage and adequate global supplies underpin the government’s stance, even as retail prices of major pulses rise by up to 12.7% year-on-year.

item.title: Jantar Mantar protest site row: Who is Abhisht Hela? Delhi advocate representing CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka
item.description: Advocate Abhisht Hela is representing two CJP leaders, Saurab Das and Ashutosh Ranka, who have been sent to five days of judicial custody. The leaders were detained after allegedly entering Jantar Mantar without authorisation, amid protests over the site’s withdrawal as a designated protest venue.

item.title: DU clears ₹5,889-crore hostel plan after Satya Niketan tragedy: Can it ease the university’s accommodation crisis?
item.description: Delhi University has approved a ₹5,889-crore hostel plan to add accommodation for 21,895 students. But with over 2.5 lakh students, limited existing hostel beds and delays in earlier projects, funding approvals and timely construction will determine whether the plan can ease the housing crisis.

item.title: Hydrogen in your kitchen gas? Petroleum regulator PNGRB proposes up to 5% blending in household piped gas; details here
item.description: PNGRB proposes up to 5% hydrogen blending in limited domestic piped-gas networks, subject to technical checks and approvals. The draft guidelines also specifically address the impact of hydrogen blending on consumer billing.

item.title: Cabinet clears ₹2,009 crore Diwali bonus for railway staff, ₹53,428 crore for social assistance
item.description: Union railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw described the 78-day bonus as a Diwali gift for employees, with each eligible non-gazetted employee entitled to a maximum payment of ₹17,951.

item.title: H-1B, L-1 visa extensions may face greater scrutiny as USCIS seeks to end deference to earlier approvals
item.description: The DHS published a proposed rule on October 14 seeking to remove Section 8 CFR 214.1(c)(5), which requires immigration officers to generally respect earlier eligibility determinations when the same parties and underlying facts are involved.

item.title: Muskan, lover receive death penalty in Meerut blue drum murder case: Why did judge invoke Mahabharata while sentencing?
item.description: Merchant navy officer Saurabh Rajput was killed on March 3, 2025 by his wife Muskan Rastogi and her lover Sahil Shukla. His body was discovered two weeks later, concealed with cement in a blue drum.

item.title: Flydubai fallout: Air France complies with Israel’s ban on crew from Pakistan, 30 other countries
item.description: Air France has confirmed it is complying with Israeli restrictions barring flight crew from 31 countries without diplomatic ties to Israel from flying to or over the country. The move follows a Flydubai incident involving an Omani co-pilot.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV’s lung cancer diagnosis: Why pulmonary adenocarcinoma can go undetected for years
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, a common type of lung cancer, following surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung. What causes this cancer, can it affect non-smokers, and why is it often difficult to detect in its early stages?

item.title: Data centre policy: Centre plans dedicated framework amid rising power demand
item.description: Projects are approved under existing environmental regulations and building rules, while several states offer incentives to attract investment in the sector.

item.title: US inflation jumps to 3.7% in September as Iran war drives gasoline prices higher
item.description: This was a notable acceleration from the 3.4 percent reading in August.
